evidence_limitations: All numerical probabilities are immutable experimental outputs with insufficient prospective qualification; no probability or action was recomputed.
Confirmation objects reproduce forecast reassessment conditions. Forecast policy invalidation triggers are null; qualitative trend failure conditions are not new policy stops.
Current intraday observations are IEX-only and cannot substitute for consolidated completed closes. Intraday volatility snapshots are missing; completed daily volatility remains separate.
Historical SEC periods differ; sponsor aggregates and partial/missing company valuation do not establish comparable forward value. Role-specific omitted evidence is not necessarily globally absent.

Correlated technical measures and repeated commentary do not create independent coverage. Unresolved sector transmission remains excluded from directional scoring; at least three accepted specialist families and critical-gap resolution are required for policy reassessment.
immediate_review_triggers: Scheduled FOMC outcome and the first subsequent completed consolidated session.
Any specified confirmation-level crossing, structural trend failure or new issuer guidance; review at the first such event rather than waiting for horizon expiry.
Official regulatory text or customer order/capex evidence that resolves an exposure or transmission gap.
golden_conclusions.market_regime: Mixed: accommodative financial-condition indicators coexist with real-yield, oil and scheduled policy-event risks. Recent price weakness contrasts with surviving longer trends; this is not evidence of a uniform risk-on regime.
golden_conclusions.overall_conclusion: Preserve WAIT for every new-position horizon and REVIEW_RISK for existing holdings. Qualitative technical support is not a qualified forecast. Probabilities below are copied experimental, uncalibrated terminal-close outputs—not confidence, intraday-entry profitability or target/stop-touch probabilities.
